text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Is this a theater prop?! It's so
detailed!

text_block_list.name: Theater Club Student
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thanks! I made it. If there's one
thing I'm
good at, it's detailed
handiwork like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Oh, there's a mini bed, too.

text_block_list.name: Theater Club Student
text_block_list.text:
They're all deeply sentimental pieces,
but the clubroom will overflow if we
keep everything.
That's why I'm trying to
decide what to throw out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that sure is a lotta stuff. Oh, I
know! How's
about I give you a hand?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin, I'm gonna help her out, so you
can go on
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nah, I'll help, too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? You will?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But I've got a favor to ask in
return.

text_block_list.name: Theater Club Student
text_block_list.text: And what's that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand done and dusted! Everything's
tidied up!

text_block_list.name: Theater Club Student
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, you two! I appreciate
your help.
And as promised, here's what
you wanted,
Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's the mini bed from before... Is that
what you
asked for in exchange for
helping out?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! I mean, you're pretty small,
but won't it
be hard to sleep if you're all
crammed into that thing?! Just the
thought is painful!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna be the one sleeping in it,

bonehead!
...I'm out of here.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Wait for me, Taishiiin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I pass by the academy gate in the
evening, I
notice Winning Ticket looking
around the area
restlessly.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I could have sworn I spotted Taishin just
now, but
she disappeared. I wonder
where she's run off to...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, there she is! Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I hope it's around right now...

text_block_list.name: Black Kitten
text_block_list.text: Mew...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, there you are. Still feeling down?
Silly fluff
ball. Here, I got you a new
bed.

text_block_list.name: Black Kitten
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff... Mraow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why're you rubbing all over me? Trying
to butter me up? Anyway, this should be
a good
replacement for that cushion of
yours.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin watches over the kitten
with a
gentle look in her eyes as it
makes itself
comfortable on the bed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right as I'm about to tell Winning Ticket
we
should head back to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! That's so touchiiing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin! I can't believe you helped out
the theater club so you could get a
present for that little
kitten! You're such
a kind soul!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Sh-shut it! And quit being a gross
stalker,
seriously! Get lost!

text_block_list.name: Black Kitten
text_block_list.text: Hiss!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Don't leave, kitty! C'mere!
There's nothing
to be afraid of!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It ran away because of you and your
megaphone
mouth! Quiet down! Or
better yet—get out of
here!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! I'm sorry, kitty! I'll be quiet, so
please
come back!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You're still yelling!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The kitten watches from a distance as
the two flail around and argue. I see
what I imagine is equal parts
bewilderment and amusement in its 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! How long have you guys been
there?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Hic! I-I'm sooo tooouuuched!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, keep it down! You'll scare the cat
away.
Geez!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This shrine here runs a community cat
program,
and they've been taking care
of this little one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Its favorite cushion was all beat up,
so it had
nothing to sleep on. Looked pretty
down about it
too, so... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
W-waaaaah! I had no idea there was
such a sad
story behind all this!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta tell everyone about this
touching tale!
Hold on, I'm gonna go
spread the word back at
the academy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What?! Don't do that, Ticket! Hey!
Come back
here, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin rushes after Winning
Ticket in a
huff while the kitten curls up
into a satisfied little
ball on its new bed.
